title: 低位双尖冠
user_directive: 这个头部还是差了些，主要是头顶的天线位置，你再找找有没有不夸张但是又偏主角感的设计
scope: 仅头冠位置/体量候选，脸部/色系/整机家族保持；旧长双槽冠脊形态重新开放，不把探索图自动认可。

references.role: same face, palette, shoulders and painting; old crown replaced

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / local head-design exploration.
ONE upper-shoulder head study of Unbranded One / M01. Camera fixed: near-frontal three-quarter view, about 20 degrees turned, eye level. Crop at upper pectorals, leave 10% margin around antenna tips. Same serious robot face and same render quality in every variant.
Input 1 is the current tall teal M01: retain the continuous narrow amber visor, smooth closed ivory face mask, angular white cheeks, small circular gold/graphite temple couplings, charcoal neck, ochre collar and ivory/teal shoulder-top construction. Retain teal/ivory/ochre palette. Slim compact faceted helmet around a small head, not a big round green bowl, not a kappa, turtle, duck beak or mascot.
Input 2 is Complete King: same-fictional-series angular helmet construction and heroic design language ONLY. M01 is the simpler mass-production relation, with latent lead-character charisma. Do not copy King's multiple gold antlers, royal emblem, gold filigree, navy/red palette or mouth/chin markings.
The PREVIOUS long white strap spanning forehead-to-rear crown is being reconsidered: REMOVE that old broad twin-slot roof strap completely for this alternative. Its precise twin-groove layout is NOT a constraint for this exploratory option. Replace with the crown specified below, rooted in an intentional location. No long yellow roof trench and no oversized helmet forehead pad.
Both ear couplings stay close to the skull with tiny SINGLE straight rearward ivory/ochre stabilizer tabs, almost flush with shell, at most 15% helmet width long. These are quiet secondary details, not upturned side ears. Face and crown symmetry is mandatory even though near and far sides differ in perspective.
The primary crown must feel restrained but recognizably heroic: clean legible silhouette, integrated structural base, purposeful angled brow and compact jaw. No huge horns, wide Gundam-style trademark head silhouette, knight helmet feathers, hair, animal ears, floating ornament or royal crown.
Style: same precise KINETIC_CEL ink and crisp two-step cel-shading as the supplied project references, large controlled color regions, no clutter of panel micro-lines, no shiny 3D toy, no photo metal. Actual transparent background, no checkerboard, haze, colored light halo, floor, labels or text. ONE head only, no front/back montage.

CROWN B — COMPACT LOW TWIN-POINT FOREHEAD CROWN: rooted at the FRONT upper brow/forehead, two slim mirrored ivory blades diverge in a NARROW low V, 22 degrees from vertical, their tips rising about 25% of helmet height above the skull. TOTAL tip-to-tip width less than HALF the helmet width, not a huge transversely spread horn. Ochre short inner bevels, one small solid ivory central forehead keystone. The blade roots meet as one compact socket above the amber visor. Clear teal top shell behind it, no roof strap, no broad yellow band. Restrained junior counterpart to King's ornate crown.
